metadata.title: External Partner Mailbox SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining trust boundaries, delegation constraints, lifecycle governance, and disclosure controls for external partner email mailboxes.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, identity, records, and regulatory baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutionally governed email capability enabling limited, controlled correspondence with external partners through mailboxes representing contractual or collaborative relationships, without granting direct mailbox access.

information-type.title: External Partner Email Content
information-type.description: Email messages exchanged with external partners via partner mailboxes under institutional control.

information-type.title: Partner Delegation and Contract State
information-type.description: Records defining which institutional roles are permitted to communicate with external partners and under what contractual terms.

information-type.title: External Partner Mailbox Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit trails binding partner mailbox communications to individual institutional actors and contractual context.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: External partner mailboxes are accessed exclusively via Delegated Send‑As / Send‑On‑Behalf SSPP.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: External partner mailboxes inherit role-based authority semantics and lifecycle governance.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: External partner mailbox service is implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: This service enables controlled correspondence with external partners under formal institutional relationship or contract.

props.name: access-model
props.remarks: External partner mailboxes do not permit direct login, authentication, or credential possession by external parties.

props.name: identity-assurance
props.remarks: Only institutional identities may act on behalf of external partner mailboxes.

props.name: delegation-scope
props.remarks: Delegated access is constrained to specific partners, purposes, and contractual contexts.

props.name: delegation-duration
props.remarks: Delegated access MUST be time‑limited and expire automatically unless renewed.

props.name: delegation-review
props.remarks: All partner-related delegations MUST undergo periodic review and re‑authorization.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: External forwarding from partner mailboxes is prohibited to prevent uncontrolled disclosure.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: External partner mailboxes MUST NOT be accessed or used by automated systems or applications.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: External partner correspondence MUST NOT include or reference information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: information-use-constraint
props.remarks: External partner mailboxes are not repositories for shared documents or long-term data storage.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Mailbox existence, access, and retention are governed by the lifecycle of the external partner relationship or contract.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of external partner mailbox content is governed by lawful authority, institutional policy, and applicable contractual terms.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All partner mailbox communications MUST be attributable to both the acting institutional individual and the partner context.

system-implementation.remarks: External partner mailbox trust is enforced through strict delegation controls, institutional identity mediation, per‑actor auditability, and centralized monitoring.

components.title: External Partner Email Mailbox
components.description: Mailbox enabling controlled, auditable external correspondence via institutional mediation.

roles.title: External Partner Relationship Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable authority for approving, maintaining, and terminating partner correspondence.

roles.title: Partner Correspondence Operator
roles.remarks: Institutional individual authorized to communicate with an external partner.

control-implementation.remarks: All controls applicable to external partner mailboxes are inherited from Delegated Send‑As SSPP, Role‑Based Mailbox SSPP, and Secure Email Platform SSPP, with additional contractual and cross‑boundary constraints.
